title: pistachio bowl gray
text: pistachio bowl gray. these bowls are sooooo awesome for pistachos... or whole nuts of any kind really.  SUPER easy to clean and just the right size.  People are always asking where I got it. (I actually own several before this one).  The gray is a bit more taupy (?) than it shows in the photo in case that matters to you.

product_metadata.title: Joseph Joseph DDWGR010GB Double Dish Pistachio Bowl and Snack Serving Bowl, Gray
features: Cleverly designed snack dish perfect for serving shelled nuts, olives, cherries, and edamame beans
Removable top dish for serving snacks
Larger bottom dish allows you to discard shells and pits, out of sight and out of the way
Can also be used as two separate dishes
Made of durable melamine; dishwasher safe; 7 inches across, 3 inches tall
description: Joseph Joseph's Double Dish Server is the perfect dish when serving nuts, olives, edemame, and other foods that require waste receptacles. Place food in top dish to serve and place shells and pits underneath - out of sight and out of the way. Dishes can also be used as separate serving dishes. Made of durable melamine. Dishwasher safe. Two-tone, white and stone.
